|errata_history={{Card errata/Black 2 (V)}}
This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Black 2 (V) (Set 0, Original)]] (version 3 of 3); it is the current text. Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' ([[Black 2 (V) (Set 0, Original)]]): Players Committee Set 0 slip sheet<ref name="eh1351-black2-0">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Virtual Card Master Set, Set 0], Players Committee, page 7. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive], captured 6 August 2016.</ref>. Dated by 6 August 2016 (the earliest preserved copy of the Set 0 slip sheet); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was this version of Black 2 (V) (Set 0, Original) first published|section=On what day were the early Virtual Modern card versions first published?}} Text: “May add 1 pilot. During your deploy phase, may ▲ one Pride Of The Empire. All Wings Report In and Organized Attack are canceled. While DS-61-2 piloting, immune to attrition &lt; 5.” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Black 2 (V)]]): Players Committee Set 0 slip sheet<ref name="eh1351-black2-1">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Virtual Card Master Set, Set 0], Players Committee, page 5. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704234722/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive], captured 4 July 2017.</ref>. Dated by 4 July 2017 (the earliest preserved copy of the errata slip); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was the PC-E1 version of Black 2 (V) first published|section=On what day were the early Virtual Modern card versions first published?}} The PC card image of 8 July 2018 (Holotable commit 022435b) prints the same text with the “E” mark. Text: “May add 1 pilot. During your deploy phase, may ▲ one Pride Of The Empire. During battle, All Wings Report In and Organized Attack are canceled. While DS-61-2 piloting, immune to attrition &lt; 5.” '''What changed:''' game text: new or changed words “During battle,”; the printed errata mark is now “E” (was “none”). It prints the errata mark “E”.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-black2-2">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/black2.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022).</ref>. First published 31 July 2022. The Players Committee announced the remastered Virtual Set 0 images on 1 August 2022. Text: “May add 1 pilot. During your deploy phase, may ▲ one Pride Of The Empire. During battle, All Wings Report In and Organized Attack are canceled. While DS-61-2 piloting, immune to attrition &lt; 5.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same: the printed errata mark is now “E1” (was “E”); the margin title lost its uniqueness dot. It prints the errata mark “E1”. This is the current text.
